comment: P25 phase 1 Network Identifier: NAC (12 bits) and DUID (4 bits) in a (63,16,23) primitive BCH code over GF(2^6), g(x) = 6331 1413 6723 5453 octal, then a 64th bit P that is the XOR of the DUID's two last bits S1, S0 (message bits 14, 15): the last column of the spec's 16 x 64 generator matrix, 1 for LDU1 and LDU2 only (not overall parity)
